description: Headless Renovate (no PR workflow; preset: homelab/default.json). It watches the Python dependencies in pyproject.toml and uv.lock, the Dockerfile's base images and the workflow's actions. deploy/afterburner/ is excluded: its CUDA base image is pinned for RunPod's drivers, and a change to that Dockerfile starts the CUDA build.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Transitive dependencies are not pinned in pyproject.toml and move only through uv.lock: one commit a week that relocks it.

packageRules.description: A release is three days old before it is taken, so a broken release is usually withdrawn or fixed before it reaches main. Every bump lands on main and deploys through build-push-deploy; the undo is a revert of the commit.
pyproject.toml and uv.lock are shared by every Python dependency; one branch for all non-major updates relocks once.
requires-python in pyproject.toml is a lower bound, not a pin; Renovate's lookup of it answers no-result and would put a warning on the dashboard every night.
